quest.title: Chasm Spelunkers
quest.description: Now that you have destroyed the Bedrock Keys, the seal on The Chasm has now come undone. It is time to venture into the depths below.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Lumenstone Ore x1

talks.objective: Enter the mines of The Chasm

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Phew, this air sure is familiar! It's been a long time since I came down into these mines.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Don't get careless, Qiong. I for one smell something unfamiliar.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I mean, we couldn't jump straight down. Maybe we were just distracted by the swaying of the crane.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: You... You've spent too much time above ground.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon didn't smell anything at all... Do all of you miners have such keen noses?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Haha! A lack of a good nose could forfeit you your life down here! That said, we should still be fine. The finches are still quite lively.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Look, the Lumenspar has grown all the way down here too. That wasn't the case the last time we came down here.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Wow, that really did happen! Let's go have a look!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know... it feels like someone just stole Paimon's thunder.

talks.objective: Investigate the Lumenspar near the camp

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uncle He left this behind.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Huh? He did, did he? Go on then, tell me!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Jinwu about what you found earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Umm... Black Magma... Lumenstone... and mushrooms?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Huh. That's weird, and a familiar sort of weird, too. Let's head back to the encampment. It would be best not to linger here.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: To think that Lumenspar would appear so close to the surface. I was always of the opinion that these things could not appear in more structurally vulnerable locations.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: They are fragments of that "thing" underground, traveling up the veins of the rock before finally arriving here.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Hey! Stop spouting nonsense. They were originally rocks from the local area, which is why they became like this. They just underwent some kind of transformation process and formed crystals, that's all.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: The analyses that the Qixing commissioned us to conduct reveal that they are by and large made of ore from the local area. They've just been affected by some outside force, thus creating these strange crystals.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh, look over there! That crystal looks just like the Adjuvant you have with you, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Why don't you take the Lumenstone Adjuvant and have a look, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: That's right. The Adjuvant is made of the same material as these crystals. These formations will thus naturally react to one another on account of that similarity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, is that all you have to say?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Um, don't fight, you two...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're not fighting...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we're not...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: What I mean to say is that it doesn't matter whether you're fighting or not. Zhiqiong and I need to set up a temporary camp up ahead, so don't run off while we're doing that.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: The crystals we discovered will be very useful for our subsequent exploration. If you find anything after this, please make sure to contact me.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: My skills haven't rusted away just yet, so I can help you process some of the raw ore. I believe that it'll prove quite useful to you in your adventures.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: And, um, also... don't fight, alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Got it, got it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Understood.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: That's a good pair of kiddos. I'll get you some candy later. Anyway, if you find anything strange nearby, please report it in a timely fashion.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Actually, do you remember what Jinwu said the last time about Uncle He...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: #I haven't forgotten. And since you're here, {NICKNAME}, could you help me out once again?

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Uncle He is our senior here in the mines. Several years ago, he was one of those who went missing when we Chasm miners were dispersed. He's hard of hearing, and may not have heard the alerts.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: The pensions from Huishan Hall and Shenglu Hall are quite generous, and his family has already long arranged for his funeral... But although I'm not much of a believer in the supernatural, I can't help but feel that he's still alive down here somewhere.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: He really was an old hand. Whether it be avoiding disasters in the mine, how to escape, how to wait for rescue... He knew it all. Taught me a lot of it, too.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: That's why I believe that he must be alive in here somewhere, even now... I won't give up searching for him.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I'll point you to a few places where he was sighted before we dispersed... Who knows? You might still be able to find some clues there.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: As for me, I'll be exploring the deeper parts of the mining caverns.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Oh yes, don't forget your candy, now!

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: She still needs to help us draw some maps. The pathways of The Chasm's underground mines are intricate and complex, and we won't get very far at all without those maps.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I'll be fine. It's not like I'm an amateur or anything. Don't you worry about me!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: #Ah, it's you, {NICKNAME}! You're here!

choices.text: Jinwu has some words for you...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's that whole spiel about safety again, isn't it? I'm sick of hearing it already.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I grew up in the mines too. What wouldn't I know about the hazards down here, huh?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: As for any unknown dangers... Eh, our seniors always used to use their experience to judge whether things were dangerous or not. And in the end, they'd use the results to rationalize their experiences instead.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I've had it up to here with their arrogance. I'm sure you feel similarly as a senior adventurer, don't you?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: If Iris was able to scare you off climbing Dragonspine just by giving you the standard safety talk, you would've missed out on so much adventure!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Alright, stop trying to persuade me. I don't want to argue with you over something this dumb. Can we just, you know, change the topic?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I mean, look over here. I'm currently studying the terrain over here, all the better to draw our maps...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: It's just that... I found that the way ahead is blocked by some... strange stuff.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: If you could take some samples or pictures of it, I'm sure that both the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Adventurers' Guild would be quite pleased.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: I would have done it, but... I dropped my Kamera while descending into the mines, so I can only rely on you now, hehe!

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Also, there are a few other spots... Yup. Here, and here. I found the tracks of Treasure Hoarders in these areas...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sorry, which place is where now? Paimon didn't understand you at all!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You just drew a bunch of Xs and lines...

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Hahaha, sorry... Just a force of habit. I always forget that not everyone is born with a natural instinct for cartography.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: But it's alright, I will follow you and show the way ahead.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: We can approach any of these few locations first, so pick whichever you like.

choices.text: Be careful while we're on the move.

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Thanks for your concern! I'll keep that in mind.

choices.text: What are you doing here again?

response.speaker: Zhiqiong
response.text: Well, didn't I just say so? I'm studying the terrain and drawing a map.

talks.objective: Look for clues as to Uncle He's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "The light is fading... My crystal lamp should last for another 4 hours..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...There's not much food left. I should be able to find the water filter from memory, but we must find a new source of light..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "Huh, those lights are floating... or are they walking? Am I starting to see things due to a lack of oxygen?"

talks.objective: Look for clues as to Uncle He's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "Some strange black magma is oozing out of the depths of the earth. I'm not sure if calling it 'magma' is precise... But it looks very ominous. Best not to get near it..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...I went deeper still and retrieved some strange mushrooms. I'm not certain if they are edible or not..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...The 'magma' seems to have attracted some elemental lifeforms. Now, if they can eat it, perhaps I could too..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...No, something's wrong. Something's gone wrong with those little things. I'd better leave. This is surely not to be taken for sustenance..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...once you get used to it, mushrooms actually don't taste too bad. It might be best to relocate to a spot where mushrooms might be found and to make camp there..."

talks.objective: Look for clues as to Uncle He's whereabouts

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...When I get too near to the black magma, my thoughts grow jumbled and my senses become agitated. But when I stand close to these crystals, these deleterious effects retreat greatly..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...I once heard Little Jinwu say that some... 'Adjuvant' thing can be used to store energy from these crystals. I should ask her about that when I get back to the surface..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...My ears itch. I can hear someone calling out to me, telling me that there is water in the depths. Mushrooms..."

dialogues.speaker: Diary Fragment
dialogues.text: "...Oh dear. I fear that I must be going quite insane..."

talks.objective: Tell Jinwu about what you've discovered of Uncle He's whereabouts
Go to the exploration team's camp
Go to the exploration team's camp

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Here we are. Strange... where'd Zhiqiong run off to...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Hey! Zhiqiong! Zhiqiong!

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'll wager she's gone running off to some other corner of this place to draw her maps again...

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: She drew this just after you left.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: She's probably gone deeper in to explore. Please tell her for me that she should quit leaving everyone else behind to go running off by herself.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: If anything bad happens, we're all gonna get dragged down with her. Jinwu's fist will know no mercy, I tell you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds... scary...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Pretty scary indeed.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Alright, then. Less idle talk, more action. You can either help me set up here, or you can go scout ahead.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Sorry if I'm not the most courteous character. I just want the things I do to be of use to everyone.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Ah yes, by the way, if you see some raw Lumenstone ore along the way, bring some to me.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: I will find some way to turn them into more effective Adjuvants. As far as my experience can tell me, these things will be very useful down in the mines.

response.speaker: Jinwu
response.text: Not yet, no. But if she keeps running off without informing me, she will be quite soon!

talks.objective: Look for Zhiqiong, who went off on her own
Return to the exploration team's camp

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, these should be the places that Jinwu mentioned. Let's head back and go look for her!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: This is all thanks to you. Please, take this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Ah, come on, there's no need to be so polite. I mean, Khedive's the one forking out the Mora! Oh, wait, shh... Best we be quiet, lest that stingy scholar from Sumeru hears us.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: *cough* Ahem. Shall we go and look for Jinwu? We can probably probe her experienced mind concerning some of the questions we had on the way.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: You know something? Jinwu doesn't like talking about this, but just like how you're famous for your exploits on Dragonspine, she was also quite the famous figure down at the mines... *cough*

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: I heard that she helped to guide the Millelith search parties, and that they saved a lot of people together. Still, those things are in the past now. I shan't mention them too much, lest she gets mad again.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Alright, I won't keep you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: This is all thanks to you. Please, take this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Ah, come on, there's no need to be so polite. I mean, Khedive's the one forking out the Mora! Oh, wait, shh... Best we be quiet, lest that stingy scholar from Sumeru hears us.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: *cough* Ahem. Shall we go and look for Jinwu? We can probably probe her experienced mind concerning some of the questions we had on the way.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiqiong
dialogues.text: Alright, I won't keep you any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: I believe that Zhiqiong should more or less be done with the map by the time you return.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: However, I still need to wait for the transport team above ground to shift our tools down here, so you're free to explore for the time being.
